SELECT sp.equipref, sp.flowhrs, sp.proccpu, sp.procgpu, sp.remaingb, sm.facetverts,
       (sp.flowhrs * sp.proccpu * sp.procgpu) / NULLIF(sp.remaingb, 0) as prutest1,
       (sp.flowhrs + sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu) / NULLIF(sm.facetverts, 0) as prutest2,
       ROUND(AVG(sp.flowhrs) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.equipref), 2) as avg_flowhrs
FROM scanprocessing sp
LEFT JOIN scanmesh sm ON sp.equipref = sm.equipref AND sp.zoneref = sm.zoneref
LIMIT 10;

-- Let's try building the full query with NTILE for classification
-- PRU = (flowhrs * proccpu * procgpu) / NULLIF(remaingb, 0) 
-- Then classify using NTILE(3) into Optimized/Acceptable/Needs Optimization
SELECT 
    e.equipregistry AS equipment_id,
    ROUND(AVG((sp.flowhrs * sp.proccpu * sp.procgpu) / NULLIF(sp.remaingb, 0)), 2) AS utilization_value,
    ROUND(AVG(sp.flowhrs), 2) AS avg_processing_time,
    CASE 
        WHEN NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY AVG((sp.flowhrs * sp.proccpu * sp.procgpu) / NULLIF(sp.remaingb, 0))) = 1 THEN 'Optimized'
        WHEN NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY AVG((sp.flowhrs * sp.proccpu * sp.procgpu) / NULLIF(sp.remaingb, 0))) = 2 THEN 'Acceptable'

    MAX(sp.flowstage) AS workflow_status,
    e.equipform || ', ' || e.equipdesign || ', ' || e.equipstatus AS resource_details
FROM equipment e
LEFT JOIN scanprocessing sp ON e.equipregistry = sp.equipref

ORDER BY utilization_value ASC
LIMIT 20;
